# Hirosuke Asahi (旭 博佑)

> Personal academic homepage of Hirosuke Asahi, a doctoral researcher at RCAST, The University of Tokyo. Fields: Information Somatics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Virtual Reality (VR), and Robotics. His research intervenes in human bodily sensation and movement — redesigning them to give rise to new kinds of experience.

This site is bilingual (English / Japanese). For AI agents and LLMs, the complete site content is available as a single Markdown document:

## Full content

- [llms-full.txt](https://qp-hiro.github.io/Homepage/llms-full.txt): Complete profile, career, publications, awards, works, skills, and contact information in Markdown

## Pages

- [Home](https://qp-hiro.github.io/Homepage/index.html): Profile, career, research & skills, works, publications & achievements, contact
- [Profile / Publications detail](https://qp-hiro.github.io/Homepage/profile.html): Detailed research achievements list with venue tags
- [Works](https://qp-hiro.github.io/Homepage/works.html): Interactive works and exhibitions
